The Treats

What comes out of the oven

Custom cakes for all special occasions — the first line of the shop's own description. Anniversary cakes included.

Cookies by the dozen and in assorted trays — 5, 10, and 15 dozen. The seasonal lists run long: ladylocks, buckeyes, creamed wafers, thumbprints, pecan tassies, and more.

Cupcakes for the occasion — named right alongside the cakes and cookies in the shop's own description.

A Johnstown staple, the shop's way: chocolate gobs and banana nut gobs, by the dozen.

Apricot, nut, poppyseed, and pumpkin rolls on the seasonal forms — plus large paska bread at Easter.

Ten-inch pies at Thanksgiving — apple to pumpkin, ten kinds — and seasonal extras like hot cocoa bombs, hot tea bombs, and DIY cookie kits.
